name: Honda Pacific Coast PC800
engine: 800 cc liquid-cooled V-twin, carbs, shaft drive
intro: Honda's enclosed commuter tourer. Most of the work is getting the bodywork off without breaking tabs.

add.title: Take the bodywork off with care
add.instructions: Follow the panel order in the manual. Bag and label every screw. Old plastic tabs crack, so work slowly and warm the panels if it's cold.
add.reason: Nearly every job on a PC800 starts with removing the body panels.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
